div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 41px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Closed loop, no reservoir: the fluid stays in the wells and picks up heat along horizontal_well.
Single fluid loop (H2O, common.fluid_name) throughout -- district_heating_hx takes the heat. Neither well has a downhole pump, so circulation_control (PumpOrValve) is the loop's only pressure source: a throttle when the thermosiphon surplus exceeds injection_pressure, a pump when it falls short.

text.tspan: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Closed loop, no reservoir: the fluid stays in the wells and picks up heat along horizontal_well.

Single fluid loop (H2O, common.fluid_name) throughout -- district_heating_hx takes the heat. Neither well has a downhole pump, so circulation_control (PumpOrValve) is the loop's only pressure source: a throttle when the thermosiphon surplus exceeds injection_pressure, a pump when it falls short.
